description: Erection of an outbuilding in rear garden.
subdivision_of_building: Basement flat and associated private rear garden
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

DWG01; DWG03; DWG05; DWG04; Tree Constraints Plan dated July 2026 prepared by GHA Trees Arboricultural Consultancy; Tree protection plan dated July 2026 prepared by GHA Trees Arboricultural Consultancy; Tree Survey and Arboricultural Impact Assessment ref. GHA/DS/127960:26 dated 30th July 2026 prepared by GHA Trees Arboricultural Consultancy; Drawing titled "Arboricultural Impact Assessment" dated July 2026 prepared by GHA Trees Arboricultural Consultancy; DWG02i; DWG06.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - Prior to the commencement of works on site, tree protection measures shall be installed and working practices adopted in accordance with the document entitled "Tree Protection Plan" and "Tree Survey and Arboricultural Impact Assessment" ref. GHA/DS/127960:26 dated 30th July 2026 by GHA Trees Arboricultural Consultancy.  All trees on the site, or parts of trees grow from adjoining sites, unless shown on the permitted drawings as being removed, shall be retained and protected from damage in accordance with BS5837:2012 and with the approved protection details. The development shall be monitored by the project arboriculturalist in accordance with the approved report.

Reason: To ensure that the development will not have an adverse effect on existing trees and in order to maintain the character and amenity of the area in accordance with the requirements of policies A2 and A3 of the Camden Local Plan and policy 18 of the Fortune Green and West Hampstead Neighbourhood Plan 2015.
Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the residential use of the dwelling known as Basement Flat, 19 Dennington Park Road, London, NW6 1BB.

Reason: To safeguard the amenity of the residential use, adjoining premises, and the area generally in accordance with policy A1 of the Camden Local Plan 2017.
